name: Pelican
note: With its Troop Bay tech it lands where it is and drops 6 Marines 5 seconds into the battle, then every 10 seconds, up to 3 drops in all; it never flies behind enemy lines (D143).

name: Spartan
note: Its laser winds up for 2.5 s before each shot; it fires every 3.5 s (was 4) to make up for the first shot coming later.

name: Jackal (Beam Rifle)
note: Snipers: few to a squad, they pick targets off from far away with slow, hard shots, and have little to stop a rush.

name: Covenant Phantom
note: With its Gravity Lift tech it drops 7 Grunts from the air 5 seconds into the battle, then every 10 seconds, up to 3 drops in all, wherever it is; it never lands (D142).

name: Zealot
note: Leaps onto its enemy, and its energy sword cuts everything around its target.

name: Spartan Sniper
note: Kills one armored target at a time from very far away; has no answer to a crowd or to anything that reaches it.

name: Spartan Heavy Weapons
note: A walking wall with a chaingun: mows down infantry, does little to armor. Under its shield, light armor.

name: Spartan Grenadier
note: Rockets in a straight line: strong against crowds, weak against tanks and flankers.

name: Spartan CQB
note: Quick on its feet with a shotgun: it runs up to its short range and fires. Very strong against artillery and DPS once there; it can't shoot aircraft.

name: Spartan Fireteam
note: Three Spartans: an all-round squad with rifles and a rocket each. No single strength, no single weakness.

name: Gremlin
note: Fast scout whose EMP slows what it hits (Titans shrug it off). Good against vehicles, poor against infantry.

name: Cobra
note: Six-wheeled tank hunter: its twin light railguns punch through heavy armor from far off. Outranges tanks; a swarm or a flanker gets under its guns.

name: Rhino
note: The longest gun in the game. Slow to turn and move, lobbed so it can miss, helpless up close.

name: Grizzly
note: The upgraded Scorpion: twin barrels and more armor, at a Tier 3 price.

name: Sparrowhawk
note: Gunship with two miniguns firing together, 15 rounds a second each: it shreds infantry and light vehicles, less so heavy armor.

name: Longsword
note: Heavy bomber. It has to fly over its target, and cannot fight other aircraft at all.

name: Vulture
note: The heaviest gunship: heavy armor, slow, long-range missiles.

name: Condor Gunship
note: A gunship: twin autocannons under its belly and five light Spartan Lasers on turrets of their own, each finding its own target.

name: Chopper
note: It rams: its main weapon is its front wheel, so it drives straight into the enemy, guns firing on the way.

name: Brute Grenadier
note: Tough infantry with lobbed grenades. Shorter range than a Fuel Rod Grunt, can miss what moves, but takes much more killing.

name: Marauder
note: The Banished battle tank. A plasma main gun, so a little better than a Scorpion against shields.

name: Reaver
note: Ground anti-air walker, weak against vehicles.

name: Skitterer
note: Spider-like machines worked by a few worms: a fast, light swarm of a flanker.

name: Goliath
note: Two colonies in one suit, fighting with its fists: it charges at what comes near, as the Hunters do. Its old job as a building-killer shows as 2.5 times the base damage if it survives a battle.

name: Hunter Captain
note: Its siphon laser gives it back 30% of the damage it deals, and friends within 12 m heal 1% per second.

name: Cannon Fodder
note: The largest squad in the game: 30 Grunts who barely fight. They are there to be shot instead of something else.

name: Heavy Grunts
note: Grunts in heavy armor with a small shield, at the top of the Tier 1 price band.

name: Grunt Goblin
note: A Grunt in a hero's mech. A quick tank with a strong aura: friends within 14 m move 20% faster and heal 0.6% per second.

name: Infested Marine
note: Fewer bodies than a Marine squad, each much tougher: it leaps in with a scythe limb. Cannot infect, as only Infection Forms do.

name: Infested Warthog
note: Drives straight into the enemy, its gun still firing.

name: Infested Scorpion
note: A little tougher and shorter-ranged than the real thing, with tentacles for what gets close.

name: Infested Hornet
note: Barely flying, still bombing.

name: Juggernaut
note: A pure form the size of a tank that moves like a flanker and leaps onto what it hunts.

name: Infested Ghost
note: Faster and lighter than the Infested Warthog.

name: Infested Elite
note: The classic combat form: no shield, more health, and a claw that opens armor.

name: Infested Wraith
note: A little tougher and shorter-ranged than the real thing.

name: Infested Banshee
note: Barely flying, still bombing.

name: Spawner
note: A mobile birthing form: it fights badly, and keeps releasing three Infection Forms and three Combat Forms in turn, one lot every 4 seconds; the Combat Forms draw the enemy's fire. Kill it first (D79, D116). With its Swarm Brood tech it also hatches a Swarm Form 5 seconds into each battle (D113, D114).
